title: Sudoku Solver
problemStatement: Given a partially filled 9 × 9 Sudoku board, fill the empty cells so that every row, every column, and every 3 × 3 subgrid contains the digits 1 through 9 exactly once. It is guaranteed that the input has exactly one solution.
input: A 9 × 9 Sudoku board where empty cells are represented by '.'.
